GenAI / AI-ML Engineer




TCS Hiring | GenAI / AI-ML Engineer | 4 to 10 Years | Face-to-Face Interview | Bengaluru




Exciting Opportunity with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)!




Position: GenAI / AI-ML Engineer




Interview Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 4 to 10 Years

Interview Date: 01 August 2026 (Saturday)

Interview Time: 9:00 AM 12:00 PM

Interview Mode: Face-to-Face Interview




Key Highlight




Face-to-Face Interview Opportunity in Bengaluru Connect directly with the hiring team and showcase your expertise in Generative AI, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning Engineering.




Key Responsibilities



Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and Machine Learning solutions for enterprise use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML models using Python and leading ML frameworks.
Develop and integrate Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications and AI-powered assistants.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and vector database solutions.
Work with structured and unstructured data to build scalable AI-driven applications.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, and engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions.
Monitor model performance, optimize inference pipelines, and ensure solution scalability.
Follow AI governance, security, and responsible AI best practices across projects.



Why Join?




Opportunity to work on cutting-edge Generative AI and AI/ML transformation initiatives

Exposure to LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, MLOps, and Cloud AI Platforms

Be part of one of Indias leading global IT services organizations




If you have 4 to 10 years of experience in GenAI and AI/ML Engineering, dont miss this opportunity to attend a Face-to-Face Interview with TCS in Bengaluru.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG and LLM experience, transferable cloud skills, meets core responsibilities.
